text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yamanin Zephyr is feeling under the weather, so I've brought her to the infirmary to get some rest.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: It seems a rough undercurrent has taken me prisoner… But given a little time, I think my body should find its stillness again…

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Oh? I've never seen this forest before. But what a lovely sunlit breeze…
'Scuse me?! Try saying that again!
Hmph. You're no match for me!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I hear a voice coming from somewhere. A voice as harsh as a screeching gale…
Ack! Watch your step! You're gonna crush us!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Oh my!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: What fluffy little Dandy-Doos! Were those your voices I heard a moment ago?

text_block_list.name: Dandelion A
text_block_list.text: Well, duh. Wasn't that obvious? …Wait! You can be the judge!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: The judge?

text_block_list.name: Dandelion B
text_block_list.text: Hey, nice idea! Okay, which one of us do you think can make our fluff fly furthest?!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: The furthest? …I'm sorry, but I don't have a ruler with me.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Oh, but we can ask that little Black Bean over there.

text_block_list.name: Dandelion B
text_block_list.text: …What? "Black bean"? Ohh, you mean the ant!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Hello, little Black Bean. I have a favor to ask of you. Would you mind gathering your friends to measure the distance traveled by these dandelions' fluff?

text_block_list.name: Ant Passerby
text_block_list.text: Hrm… I have my own affairs to tend to, actually. But I might entertain the idea of assisting you if you offer me something sweet.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Something sweet… Perhaps you'd enjoy some flower nectar? Excuse me, little Dandy-Doo, but could I have a little of your nectar, please?

text_block_list.name: Dandelion A
text_block_list.text: We're all fluffed out over here. We don't have any nectar to share.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Oh, of course. I suppose I'll need to look for another flower that can share its nectar with me.

text_block_list.name: Ant Passerby
text_block_list.text: Um… As I previously mentioned, I'm actually rather busy. If you don't have anything on hand, I'll be taking my leave.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Oh no! Wait a moment, little Black Bean!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Aw… It went between two stones… What should I do now? I can't fit into that crevice…

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Actually… Perhaps if I breathe in a little…

text_block_list.name: Dandelion A
text_block_list.text: Bahaha! C'mon, you don't have to go that far! Listen, we're sorry. We shouldn't have been fighting about this in the first place!

text_block_list.name: Dandelion A
text_block_list.text: To make it up to you… we'll let you play with us. How about it?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Oh my… You'd let me join you? Frolicking with the Dandy-Doos… Yes, I'd like to try that.

text_block_list.name: Dandelion B
text_block_list.text: Nice! C'mon, let's play! How about we look for clouds with funny shapes? We can try to find ones that look like animals!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Hehe. That sounds fun. …Oh, look. That cloud resembles a turtle, don't you think?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: …Hm? Was I dreaming?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Hehe. But what a tender breeze of a dream it was. And yet, an efflorescent breeze at the same time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It looks like Yamanin Zephyr had a pleasant dream. With a sunny smile on her face, she seems full of vitality again.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Well… I suppose I can measure the distance by counting my steps.

text_block_list.name: Dandelion B
text_block_list.text: Okay, sounds good! Let's do this!

text_block_list.name: Dandelion B
text_block_list.text: Go on! Fly!

text_block_list.name: Dandelion A
text_block_list.text: Pfft! Hey! What're you blowing your fluff over here for?! Two can play at that game!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Oh… Most of the fluff fell around you. Um… Whose was whose again?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Okay… Just a moment… This fluff traveled two steps… and this one managed around three, I think…

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: And, um… Whose were these two pieces of fluff?

text_block_list.name: Dandelion A
text_block_list.text: I dunno either. Bro keeps blowing fluff in my direction, so there's no telling what belongs to who.

text_block_list.name: Dandelion B
text_block_list.text: Psh! You wanna take things up a notch, eh?!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Oh dear… You're both kicking up an awful storm… What should I do?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: …Oh!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Sigh… I was no help to the Dandy-Doos.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: If only I'd been more like a spring breeze, I could have warmed up their wintry fuss…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm guessing Yamanin Zephyr had a bad dream. That nap doesn't seem to have improved her condition much.
